question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2
solution:
The correct answer is '**used to**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "used to" is commonly used to indicate something that was done in the past or a previous state of something.
 
• In the given passage, "used to" correctly fits the context of describing how the term monsoon was traditionally applied.
 
• "**Uses to**" and "**Using to**" are grammatically incorrect.
 
• "**Use to**" is incorrect because "use" does not function as a past participle in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Using to" is incorrect as "using" does not follow the appropriate verb form required here.
 
• "Uses to" is incorrect as "uses" is the third-person singular present form, which does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• "Use to" is incorrect because "use" in this context should be in the past form, which is "used to".
